beliefs: Only the first character of a string is transformed; the rest is copied unchanged (abc→cbc, abcdef→cbcdef, xyz→zyz, zoo→boo, cat→eat, dog→fog, Hello→Jello) [E3, E4]
Lowercase vowels are shifted forward by 2 (a→c, e→g, i→k, o→q, u→w) [E2, E4]
Lowercase consonants are shifted forward by 1 (b→c, c→d, d→e, x→y, z→a, h→j, t→v) [E2, E3, E4]
Uppercase letters are shifted forward by 2 (H→J, Z→B, A→C) [E1, E3, E4]
Digits, punctuation, and spaces are left unchanged [E1, E4]
The first-character rule applies regardless of case: first char shifted, remaining chars verbatim [E3, E4]
notes: E4 confirms only the first character is transformed (xyz→zyz, zoo→boo, cat→eat, dog→fog), so the first-char-only rule stands; my v3 code was correct but the belief list had drifted, so I restored the first-char-only belief and kept the vowel/consonant/uppercase shift rules.
